content.short: Hipo Finance is an open-source liquid staking protocol on TON, issuing hTON to stakers for maximum utility.
content.description: Hipo Finance is an open-source, community-driven liquid staking protocol built on the TON blockchain. It provides a transparent platform for users to stake their Toncoin and receive hTON tokens, which capture staking rewards while remaining fully transferable and usable in other decentralized applications. Hipo Finance emphasizes decentralized governance and security, offering a reliable path for users to support the TON network while maintaining complete control over their asset liquidity.
